actor.description: Who caused this event: a tracker login for a human decision, or the literal "engine" where the engine decided autonomously and that fact is itself the audit record (an auto-approved gate). ABSENT means the engine acted mechanically -- absence is the answer, not a gap, so "every externally-caused event" is `actor` present.

source.description: What carried the cause: a comment id, an intake event key, or a run id. Pairs with `actor` so a decision can be traced back to the artifact it arrived on without parsing `detail`.
